name: Shenqiornis
sum: Bohaiornithid from the Qiaotou Member of the Huajiying Formation of Hebei, of uncertain Early Cretaceous age.
holotype: DNHM D2950-2951, plate and counterplate of a largely complete subadult skeleton.
biology: Not given in the sources used.
author: Wang et al. 2010

sources.text: X. Wang, J. O'Connor, and B. Zhao, L. M. Chiappe, C. Gao, X. Cheng. 2010. New species of Enantiornithes (Aves: Ornithothoraces) from the Qiaotou Formation in northern Hebei, China. Acta Geologica Sinica 84(2):247-256

dates_note: The Qiaotou Member may correlate with the Yixian Formation; PBDB gives a wide range (Oxfordian–Barremian).
